description: Quantum Incursions map overview and node extended info.

captures.sourceHar: collected coins production in quantum settlement.har
collected coins production in quantum settlement.har

reward.name: 26,000 Quantum Coins
reward.description: Quantum Coins can be gained from the Quantum Settlement and as Node Rewards. They will reset after every Quantum Incursion season.

reward.name: 26,000 Quantum Supplies
reward.description: Quantum Supplies can be gained from the Quantum Settlement and as Node Rewards. They will reset after every Quantum Incursion season.

reward.name: 25 Quantum Shards
reward.description: Quantum Shards can be gained from the Quantum Pass. This special resource is used for special actions like skipping production times. Quantum Shards will reset after a Quantum Championship.

reward.name: 5,000 Quantum Medals
reward.description: Quantum Medals can be obtained as rewards in Quantum Incursions. Use them to buy Quantum Expansions for your City.

reward.name: 20 Forge Points
reward.description: Use Forge Points to research technologies or contribute them to Great Buildings.

reward.name: 1,050 Lunar Coins
reward.description: Collect Lunar Coins as a reward in the Quantum Incursions. This currency does not expire.
